name: Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840
description: nRF52840 BLE XIAO with 1 MB internal plus 2 MB QSPI flash, USB-C, battery charger and RGB LED; standby draw under 5 uA in a 21 x 17.8 mm board.
notes: Ceramic on-board antenna only (no U.FL); NFC pins accessible on back pads; 11 GPIO on the side pads.
UF2 bootloader (double-tap reset); a larger 'Plus' version with 20 pins is a separate product.
Standard 14-pad XIAO footprint (7 per side, 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm row spacing); header coordinates assume the pads are centred on the 21 mm board length.
